claim: Equivalence between absence of an anticanonical polar cylinder on S and absence of a principal open cylinder in its specified affine hypersurface complement.

scope.surface: Normal projective integral del Pezzo surface with at worst Du Val singularities
separate_elementary_cases: Normal integral quadric in P^3, smooth or rank-3 cone
scope.polar_boundary: Effective rational divisor Q-linearly equivalent to -K_S; cylinder is complement of its support
scope.affine_cylinder: Nonempty principal open set isomorphic to Z times A^1, with Z affine

prior_result.author: Jihun Park
prior_result.exact_statement_inspected: Corollary 3.2 in the institutional preprint CGP18017
prior_result.published_exact_scope_crosscheck: Theorem 4.20 of Cylinders in Fano varieties, EMS Surveys in Mathematical Sciences 8 (2021), 39–105

normalization_note: Complete standard local proof: clear once, remove maximal common F-power; equivalently choose least clearing exponent over all integers. Not a refutation of Park or an audit of every cited proof.
general_theorem_boundary: Survey Theorem 4.25 is one-way and retains normality, ample Cartier, weighted section-ring presentation and complete degree-d embedding hypotheses.
excluded: Arbitrary embeddings, ground fields, positive characteristic, worse singularities or unrelated Fano varieties
